parsed.name: 可编程直流电源
parsed.description: 基于 VISA 接口的通用可编程直流电源设备，用于实验中为被测对象提供受控电压或电流输出。现有证据仅支持其为通用电源类仪器，未显示具体型号或更细的硬件能力。
parsed.description_en: A generic VISA-controlled programmable DC power supply used in laboratory experiments to provide controlled voltage or current output to a device under test. The available evidence supports only a general power-supply instrument classification, without a specific model or more detailed hardware capabilities.

actions.description: 初始化电源设备连接与基本通信状态。
actions.description_en: Initialize the power supply connection and basic communication state.
